alert.button: Tell me when it is back
alert.hint: Leave your email and we will write once, when it is back. We use it for nothing else.
alert.thanks: Thank you. We will write to you once, when it is back.
alert.title: Back in stock
card.all: The card pays all of it
card.all_text: If it holds less than the total, the order is not placed and you choose how to pay the rest.
card.hint: Have a code? We take what the card holds, up to the total, and the rest is paid by the method you choose below.
card.less: What if the card holds less than the total?
card.less_text: The part it holds is held on the card for this order, and nothing is charged until the rest is paid. Once you pay the rest, the held part is taken from the card. If the rest is not paid in time, the hold is let go, the card is untouched and the order is cancelled.
card.more_text: If the card holds more than the total, only the total is taken and the balance stays on the card. Your order page says how much of the card was used.

cart.empty_text: Find something you like and add it here.

checkout.place_hint: The country, region and postal code decide your tax and delivery. The total is worked out for them as soon as you give them.
checkout.reminder: Email me a reminder if I leave something in my cart
checkout.reminder_note: (optional: used for nothing else, and you can say no)
codes.not_applicable: is on the cart, but it does not apply to what is in it
delivery.none: We cannot deliver to that place. Change the country, region or postal code, or contact the store.
delivery.none_back: We cannot deliver to that place. Go back, change the country, region or postal code, or contact the store.
